source_name: Shopify developer changelog: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
finding: Inventory holds for active draft orders, open transfers, and open shipments are moving from reserved to committed. Available and on_hand are unaffected; total inventory is unchanged.
affected_plan: Video ve Shopify Otomasyonu / Shopify product validation
old_approach: Treat reserved quantity as the specific signal for draft-order and transfer/shipment holds.
new_rule_or_hypothesis: For affected shops, use committed rather than reserved to detect draft-order or transfer/shipment holds. Do not interpret the migration as a change in sellable available inventory or total inventory.
test_or_metric: When validating inventory, read available/on_hand plus committed; if reserved falls while committed rises during migration, classify as state migration rather than demand or stock loss.
failure_fallback: If shop migration status or inventory-state semantics are unknown, mark HOLD_STATE_UNVERIFIED and do not infer sellable-stock change from reserved/committed alone.
provenance: Official Shopify developer changelog dated 2026-08-05; checked 2026-10-05.
